newsitem.title: USA: Steris to buy Bristol-Myers Calgon assets.
newsitem.headline: Steris to buy Bristol-Myers Calgon assets.

text.p: Steris Corp said on Wednesday it agreed to buy assets of the infection and contamination control business of Bristol-Myers Squibb Co's Calgon Vestal Laboratories Inc for $75 million cash.
The company said the transaction, subject to certain conditions, was expected to close by the end of December.

Calgon Vestal's infection control business competes in the $1.3 billion global market for instrument cleaning and decontamination, antimicrobial and routine hand washing cleansers, hard surface disinfectants, and surgical scrubs used by healthcare providers, Steris said.

Bill Sanford, chairman, president, and chief executive officer, said one of Steris's main goals has been to expand the consumable part of its product line to include surface cleaners, decontaminants, disinfectants and sterilants.
"After the acquisition, revenues from consumables and services will account for more than 45 percent of Steris's total business," Sanford said.
